scientific_integrity: General claims are supported by an explicit bijective proof. Independent direct finite enumeration checks are corroborative and not a substitute for a proof. No independent audit or independent validation has been performed. The earliest verified exact-date public background source selected is the first arXiv posting of arXiv:1009.2892 on 2010-09-15; a relevant 2003 published article is separately cited but its day of first public availability was not established.
scientific_limitations: The exact formula applies only to finite Cartesian products of two nonempty chains as individually named random-poset parameters. The generic ideal/filter type correspondence and standard path-counting inputs predate the finding; the evaluated two-parameter expression, square-grid asymptotic and fixed-width degree are the claim. A classical 1980 insertion-position article was not available in full text; unindexed equivalent coverage remains a risk.
title: Exact one-point type spectrum over rectangular chain-product parameters
